movie.overview: Genius Belgian detective Hercule Poirot investigates the murder of an American tycoon aboard the Orient Express train.
movie.title: Murder on the Orient Express

recommendations.title: Murder on the Orient Express
recommendations.overview: In 1935, when his train is stopped by deep snow, detective Hercule Poirot is called on to solve a murder that occurred in his car the night before.

recommendations.title: Miss Marple: They Do It with Mirrors
recommendations.original_title: Miss Marple: They Do It with Mirrors
recommendations.overview: At the insistence of Ruth Van Rydock, an old schoolfriend who is convinced that there is something wrong, Miss Marple agrees to visit 'Stonygates', the country house of Ruth's sister.

recommendations.title: Evil Under the Sun
recommendations.overview: An opulent beach resort provides a scenic background to this amusing whodunit as Poirot attempts to uncover the nefarious evildoer behind the strangling of a notorious stage star.

recommendations.title: Appointment with Death
recommendations.overview: Emily Boynton, the stepmother to three children, blackmails the family lawyer into destroying a second will of her late husband that would have freed the children from her dominating influence. She takes herself, the children, and her daughter-in-law on holiday to Europe and the Holy Land. At a dig, Emily is found dead and Hercule Poirot investigates.

recommendations.title: Thirteen at Dinner
recommendations.overview: Actress Jane Wilkinson wants a divorce, but her husband, Lord Edgware, refuses. She convinces Hercule Poirot to use his famed tact and logic to make her case. Lord Edgware turns up murdered, a well-placed knife wound at the base of his neck. It will take the precise Poirot to sort out the lies from the alibis - and find the criminal before another victim dies.

recommendations.title: Death on the Nile
recommendations.overview: Belgian sleuth Hercule Poirot's Egyptian vacation aboard a glamorous river steamer turns into a terrifying search for a murderer when a picture-perfect couple's idyllic honeymoon is tragically cut short.

recommendations.title: Murder in Three Acts
recommendations.overview: In Acapulco, Hercule Poirot attends a dinner party in which one of the guests clutches his throat and suddenly dies. The causes seem to be natural until another party with most of the same guests produces another corpse.

recommendations.title: Sherlock: The Abominable Bride
recommendations.overview: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson find themselves in 1890s London in this holiday special.

recommendations.title: Agatha and the Truth of Murder
recommendations.original_title: Agatha and the Truth of Murder
recommendations.overview: England, December 1926. Although her personal life is in tatters, the famous writer Agatha Christie decides to leave everything behind to help unravel an unsolved murder committed on a train six years ago, unable to imagine the disproportionate consequences that such a selfless act will cause.

recommendations.title: The Maltese Falcon
recommendations.overview: A private detective takes on a case that involves him with three eccentric criminals, a beautiful liar, and their quest for a priceless statuette.

recommendations.title: Miss Fisher and the Crypt of Tears
recommendations.original_title: Miss Fisher and the Crypt of Tears
recommendations.overview: After freeing a young Bedouin girl from her unjust imprisonment in Jerusalem, an Australian adventuress, together with her devoted police detective friend, begins to unravel a decade-old mystery concerning priceless emeralds, an ancient curse and the disappearance of the girl's mother and massacre of her tribe.

recommendations.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Reunited and It Feels So Deadly
recommendations.original_title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Reunited and It Feels So Deadly
recommendations.overview: Aurora's high school reunion turns deadly when a body is found in the hotel pool. Aurora and her Real Murders Club help investigate which classmate was most likely to kill.

recommendations.title: The Mask of Dimitrios
recommendations.overview: A mystery writer is intrigued by the tale of notorious criminal Dimitrios Makropolous, whose dead body was found washed up on the shore in Istanbul. He decides to follow the career of Dimitrios around Europe, in order to learn more about the man. Along the way he is joined by the mysterious Mr. Peters, who has his own motivation.

recommendations.title: Before and After
recommendations.overview: Two parents deal with the effects when their son is accused of murdering his girlfriend.

recommendations.title: Robbery
recommendations.overview: In this fictionalised account of the Great Train Robbery, career criminal Paul Clifton plans an audacious crime: the robbery of a mail train carrying millions in cash.

recommendations.title: Enola Holmes
recommendations.overview: While searching for her missing mother, intrepid teen Enola Holmes uses her sleuthing skills to outsmart big brother Sherlock and help a runaway lord.

recommendations.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: How to Con A Con
recommendations.original_title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: How to Con A Con
recommendations.overview: When Aida Teagarden's real estate client is found murdered, her sleuthing daughter Aurora sets out with her fiancé Nick and the Real Murders Club to solve the murder.

recommendations.title: The Woman in the Window
recommendations.overview: A seductive woman gets an innocent professor mixed up in murder.

recommendations.title: Agatha and the Midnight Murders
recommendations.overview: As bombs fall on London, writer Agatha Christie decides it is time to kill off her most famous creation.

recommendations.title: Enola Holmes 3
recommendations.overview: Adventure follows detective Enola Holmes to Malta, where her plans to tie the knot unravel when Sherlock's disappearance plunges her into a perilous case.
